check.title: Stock check
check.intro: Count what is left after the event. Stock is corrected; if items are missing, a forgotten order is flagged on the event. Lines left empty are not counted.
check.soldOnly: Only items sold at the event
check.saved: Stock check saved: {count} item counted. | Stock check saved: {count} items counted.

discrepancies.title: Probable missing order: {count} item (≈ {amount} in sales) | Probable missing order: {count} items (≈ {amount} in sales)
discrepancies.hint: The stock check found fewer items than expected. Add the order forgotten during the event — stock will not be deducted twice — or dismiss the difference (breakage, loss, gift).
discrepancies.dismissMessage: The difference on “{label}” will no longer be flagged as a missing order.
